serverInfo.title: Christian Streetwear & Faith Apparel (Trucker Hats, Foam Clogs, Tees, Hoodies)
serverInfo.description: Authentic Christian streetwear designed to break free from cheesy slogans and dated church cliches. Premium heavyweight faith apparel crafted with modern typography, streetwear silhouettes, and deep biblical conviction: structured 5-panel foam trucker hats, Golden Cross slip-on EVA foam clogs, vintage-wash heavyweight graphic tees, and fleece hoodies. Features scripture search (Romans 8:37, Exodus 3:5), thoughtful baptism and milestone gift curation, fit guidance, and 1-click Shopify checkout.

tools.name: search_armornglory_products
tools.description: Search authentic Christian streetwear, modern faith apparel, structured 5-panel foam trucker hats, Golden Cross EVA foam clogs, heavyweight graphic tees, and cozy fleece hoodies. Built with an Anti-Beige, anti-cheesy aesthetic that pairs modern typography and heavyweight streetwear cuts with deep biblical conviction (Romans 8:37, Exodus 3:5, Matthew 6:33). Filter by keyword, scripture, category, aesthetic vibe, color, size, or price. Returns product stories, sizing advice, images, and 1-click checkout permalinks.
